description.value: You unleash a blast of hellish fire. Each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] around you takes @Damage[((floor(@item.level/2) -1 ) * 2)d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage and @Damage[1d4[persistent,spirit]|options:area-damage] damage, with a basic @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. This damage increases by 2d6 at 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter.
